title: Oak Decorated Pots
description: Changes the decorated pots to be made of oak logs and oak planks
body:
Have you ever thought to yourself, man decorated pots are so ugly and they never fit with my wooden builds? well probably not but that is besides the point. This resourcepack changes the decorated pots textures to be made of oak logs and planks so that it looks 100x better.

Discord: Zyqwyx
